_about: Public-domain Philaret (Drozdov), Metropolitan of Moscow (1782-1867), in English for the Word Hoard: The Doctrine of the Russian Church, being the Primer, the Shorter and Longer Catechisms (the Longer being Philaret's) and a Treatise on the Duty of Parish Priests, translated by R. W. Blackmore (Aberdeen, 1845), from an Internet Archive scan. The title page does not name Philaret. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 27 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

philaret-doctrine-russian-church: The Doctrine of the Russian Church: the Primer, the Shorter and Longer Catechisms, and a Treatise on the Duty of Parish Priests, tr. R. W. Blackmore (Aberdeen: A. Brown, MDCCCXLV)

_alternates.philaret-copies: The London (Joseph Masters) issue of 1845 and another Aberdeen copy

_alternates.philaret-catechism-1901: The Catechism of the Orthodox Catholic Eastern Church (San Francisco, 1901): names neither Philaret nor a translator

_excluded.philaret-other: Moschakis's catechism (1894) and a Russian-language edition
